seo.description_so: Sida BajGo u shaqeeyo: dooro meesha, arag qiimaha, la soco darawalkaaga. Safar iyo dirid Bajaaj ah oo Garoowe ah.
seo.description_en: How BajGo works: choose your places, see your fare, track your driver. Bajaaj rides and deliveries in Garowe.

so.headline: Saddex tallaabo. Hal taabasho.
so.sub: BajGo waxaa loo sameeyay in qof kasta isticmaali karo: taleefan iyo lambar keliya ayaad u baahan tahay.

en.headline: Three steps. One tap.
en.sub: BajGo is built so anyone can use it: all you need is a phone and a number.

steps.title: Soo deji oo gal
steps.body: Soo deji app-ka, geli lambarkaaga taleefanka, oo geli koodhka fariinta ahaan laguu soo diray. Furaha sirta ah looma baahna.

steps.title: Dooro meelaha
steps.body: Qor meesha aad joogto iyo meesha aad u socoto. Haddii cinwaan sax ah aadan haysan, biinka ka dhig khariidadda oo qor calaamad u dhow, sida masjid ama dukaan.

steps.title: Arag qiimaha oo xaqiiji
steps.body: Qiimaha oo dhammaystiran ayaa lagu tusayaa ka hor intaadan xaqiijin. Wuxuu ku salaysan yahay masaafada waddada.

steps.title: La soco darawalkaaga
steps.body: Darawalka ugu dhow ayaa helaya codsigaaga. Waxaad arkaysaa magaciisa, koodhka gaariga (tusaale BG-0142), taarikada iyo meesha uu joogo. Isku hubi koodhka ka hor intaadan fuulin.

steps.title: Bixi oo qiimee
steps.body: Bixi lacag caddaan ah marka safarku dhammaado. Qiimee darawalka. Rasiidh ayaad ka helaysaa app-ka.

steps.title: Download and sign in
steps.body: Get the app, enter your phone number, and type the code sent to you by SMS. No password needed.

steps.title: Choose your places
steps.body: Type where you are and where you're going. If you don't have an exact address, drop a pin on the map and add a nearby landmark, such as a mosque or shop.

steps.title: See the fare and confirm
steps.body: The full fare is shown before you confirm. It is based on road distance.

steps.title: Track your driver
steps.body: The nearest driver receives your request. You see their name, fleet code (for example BG-0142), plate and live location. Check the fleet code before you get in.

steps.title: Pay and rate
steps.body: Pay cash when the trip ends. Rate your driver. You get a receipt in the app.

steps.title: Sharax xirmada
steps.body: Dooro nooca (cunto, xirmo, dukumeenti, dawo, alaabta suuqa) iyo cabbirka (yar, dhexdhexaad, weyn). Qor magaca iyo lambarka qaataha.

steps.title: Dooro meelaha oo xaqiiji
steps.body: Meesha laga qaadayo iyo meesha la geynayo. Qiimaha ayaa lagu tusayaa ka hor.

steps.title: La soco xirmada
steps.body: Darawalku wuu soo qaadaa, adiguna waxaad arkaysaa meesha ay joogto.

steps.title: Koodhka qaataha
steps.body: Marka darawalku gaaro, qaatuhu wuxuu helayaa koodh 4-lambar ah. Darawalku wuxuu geliyaa koodhka ka hor intuusan xirmada dhiibin.

steps.title: Describe the parcel
steps.body: Choose the category (food, parcel, documents, pharmacy, shopping) and the size (small, medium, large). Add the recipient's name and number.

steps.title: Choose the places and confirm
steps.body: Where to collect and where to deliver. The fare is shown first.

steps.title: Track the parcel
steps.body: The driver collects it, and you see where it is.

steps.title: Recipient code
steps.body: When the driver arrives, the recipient receives a 4-digit code. The driver enters the code before handing over the parcel.
